THE FIGHT MANUAL

MAKE EVERY HIT COUNT.

MOVEMENT & DEFENCE

Move / hold back to blockAD
Crouch / hopSW
Sidestep in / outQE
DashTAP A OR D TWICE
Pause / muteESCM

ATTACKS

Left punch / right punchUI
Left kick / right kickJK
Throw / break a throwH OR U+J
Uppercut launcherS+I OR L
Low sweepS+K
01 / THREE-HIT STRINGSU → I → K

Press the next button as a hit lands. Also try J → K → J, or I → U → I.

02 / BREAK THE GUARDD + K

Forward + kick hits mid. Low kicks beat standing guard. Mid attacks beat crouch.

03 / GET OFF THE FLOORU / J

Press a punch or kick when you land to recover faster. Sidestep straight attacks.

GAMEPAD: stick / D-pad to move · X / Y: punches · A / B: kicks · LB / RB: sidestep · LT: throw · RT: launcher · START: pause.
PS PAD: □ / △ punches · × / ○ kicks.   LOCAL 2P: arrow keys · 7 / 8: punches · 9 / 0: kicks · Right Ctrl: throw · , / .: sidestep. Numpad 4 / 5 / 1 / 2 also work.
PRACTICE: T changes the dummy between idle, guard, and fight. R resets health and position. Neutral guard blocks high and mid attacks.
